entries.text: 如果和上次一樣，\n說不定這次也……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_01

entries.text: 果然是這一派啊～！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_02

entries.text: 真的在這裡！\n絕對沒錯，這就是調味料！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_03

entries.text: 嗯～讓我來瞧瞧……\n書上是怎麼說的呢？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_05

entries.text: 據說[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]秘傳：甜味料[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]有健胃效果，\n能幫助促進消化食物！\c\n對肚子痛和食慾不振也是效果絕佳！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_a

entries.text: 據說[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]秘傳：鹹味料[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]可以\n舒緩手腳的疼痛和麻痺！\c\n對於改善肌肉力量的衰退也有效果！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_b

entries.text:
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]秘傳：苦味料[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]能促進血液循環！
幫助血液流動得更加通暢！\c
能讓身體變得暖洋洋，
同時提升免疫力……書上是這麼說的！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_c

entries.text:
據說[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]秘傳：酸味料[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]能滋補強身！
當中含有豐富的營養！\c
對疲憊的身心非～常有效，
一轉眼就能恢復活力！！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_d

entries.text:
書上說[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]秘傳：辣味料[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]會提升代謝！
具有改善循環功能的效果。\c
身體裡面的毒素會跟著
大量的汗水一起排出去！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_e

entries.text: 如果也能把這東西\n料理好給牠吃的話……！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_06

entries.text: 好，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n該吃飯了，吃飯！\r\n我馬上來準備！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_07

entries.text: 哇喔喔喔喔喔喔！\n嘿呀！派呀～！！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_29

entries.text: 久等了！\c\n派帕特製一派隨興\n調味料滿滿三明治上桌！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_08

entries.text: 同時附上代表謝意的寶主徽章……\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳拿去吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_09

entries.text: 啊嗄嘶！
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_01

entries.text: ……我的天啊，怎麼又來了！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_10

entries.text: 嗅嗅……
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_02

entries.text: 要把三明治\n給[VAR 0x0101(0001)]嗎？
entries.label: legend_0030_system_02

entries.text: 給牠！
entries.label: legend_0030_select_01

entries.text: 不給
entries.label: legend_0030_select_02

entries.text: 咕啾……
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_03

entries.text: 還是把三明治\n給[VAR 0x0101(0001)]如何呢？
entries.label: legend_0030_system_03

entries.text: 嘎啊嘶。
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_04

entries.text: 哼，牠那是在道謝嗎……？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_11

entries.text: 我預先多做了一些三明治，\n真是太正確了。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_12

entries.text: 我先說這是為了慰勞\n努力幫忙的[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳才做的。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_13

entries.text: 呼嚕呼嚕……！
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_05

entries.text: 啊嗄～嘶！
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_06

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n學會了坐騎招式：衝刺！
entries.label: legend_0030_system_04

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n學會了坐騎招式：高跳！
entries.label: legend_0030_system_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n學會了坐騎招式：滑翔！
entries.label: legend_0030_system_06

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n學會了坐騎招式：衝浪！
entries.label: legend_0030_system_07

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n學會了坐騎招式：攀崖！
entries.label: legend_0030_system_08

entries.text: 總覺得牠好像又成長了？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_15

entries.text: 啊嘎！
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_07

entries.text: 果然秘傳調味料的\n效果就是驚人～[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_16

entries.text: ……不驚人的話，\n我可就傷腦筋了。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_17

entries.text: 嗅嗅……！
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_08

entries.text: 啊嘎～？
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_09

entries.text: 那不是給你的！！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_19

entries.text: 啊嘎……？
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_10

entries.text: 啊……抱歉。\n我不該那麼大聲的。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_20

entries.text: 這傢伙是獒教父，\n牠是我的搭檔。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_23

entries.text: 啊……嘎啊。
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_11

entries.text: 來，吃一點能幫忙\n恢復活力的三明治吧。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_24

entries.text: 你小口小口地吃不要緊。\n要慢慢地、慢慢地咬喔。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_26

entries.text: 這傢伙不久之前……\n受了很重的傷。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_27

entries.text: 在那之後，\n牠的身體就一直很差……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_28

entries.text: 傷藥沒用嗎？
entries.label: legend_0030_select_03

entries.text: 寶可夢中心呢？
entries.label: legend_0030_select_04

entries.text: 不論是傷藥還是寶可夢中心，\n都治不好牠。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_29a

entries.text: 他們說牠的狀況\n不是普通的傷或疾病。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_29b

entries.text: ……對我來說，\n最重要的只有獒教父這傢伙而已。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_30

entries.text: 我發誓不論用什麼樣的方法，\n都一定要治好牠。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_31

entries.text: 所以我在網路和書上\n調查了許多種治療方法，\r\n而且幾乎都嘗試過了。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_32

entries.text: 但不論哪一個方法都不太有效，\n正當我快要放棄的時候……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_33

entries.text: 我終於發現了\n秘傳調味料的存在！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_34

entries.text: 那本書是？
entries.label: legend_0030_select_05

entries.text: 你調查得真仔細
entries.label: legend_0030_select_06

entries.text: 我在我媽的\n研究所裡找到的。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_35a

entries.text: 我在我爸的\n研究所裡找到的。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_35b

entries.text: 我在我媽的研究所裡\n找到了這本書。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_36a

entries.text: 我在我爸的研究所裡\n找到了這本書。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_37b

entries.text: 這本怪力亂神的書誰也不會信，\n裡面盡寫些胡說八道的內容。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_38

entries.text: 但是，我相信那些都是真的！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_39

entries.text: 按照這本書的話，\n只要吃下５種秘傳調味料，\r\n不論受什麼傷生什麼病，都能治好！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_40

entries.text: 實際上獒教父吃了上一種調味料之後，\n牠原本冰冷無比的手腳\r\n變得稍微暖和一點點了喔。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_41

entries.text: 啊，你吃完了嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_42

entries.text: 哇哇哇！獒教父！\n你這是……！\r\n你的眼睛能看得見了嗎！？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_43

entries.text: 太好了！太好了！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_44

entries.text: 一直以來……一直以來！\n牠的眼睛都沒有睜開！\r\n我真的超擔心的……！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_45

entries.text: 嗚嗚……太好了！\n真的是太好了……！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_46

entries.text: 唔……嘻、嘻哈哈哈……！\n牠圓圓的眼睛太小了，\r\n有沒有睜開我都搞不清楚了～！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_47

entries.text: 調味料的力量好厲害！\n果然是貨真價實！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_48

entries.text: 我絕對要讓獒教父\n恢復到像以前一樣，\r\n充滿活力的樣子。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_49

entries.text: ……事情就是這樣，所以啊～[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_50

entries.text: 我們要找的調味料剩下３種！\n一起加油吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_51

entries.text: 啊嘎！啊嘎！
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_12
